; VU1 registers:
;   VF01 viewport scale, VF02 viewport offset, VF03 color scale
;   VF10.. shader inputs, VF20 gl_Position, VF21 color output
;   VF25-VF26 the previous two screen positions (culling)
;   VF05-VF09, VF18-VF19, VF27-VF31 push constants, uniforms, constants and temporaries
;   VI02 vertices left, VI03 input pointer, VI04 output base, VI05 output pointer
;   VI06 index pointer, VI07 qwords per vertex, VI08 scratch, VI09 index list offset
;   (0 = in order), VI10 first vertex, VI11 vertices to the next triangle, VI12 vertices
;   per triangle (0 = no culling), VI13 scratch, VI14 instances left, VI15 instance pointer

		.global	tess_isolines_tese_CodeEnd
tess_isolines_tese_CodeStart:
; prologue: constants and the batch header
         NOP                                      lq            VF01,0(VI00)
         NOP                                      lq            VF02,1(VI00)
         NOP                                      lq            VF03,2(VI00)
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI01,VI00,80               ; input base
         NOP                                      lq            VF04,0(VI01)               ; GIF tag for each instance
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI13,2(VI01)               ; qword offset of the first vertex
         NOP                                      ilw.y         VI09,1(VI01)               ; index list offset, 0 = vertices in order
         NOP                                      iadd          VI10,VI01,VI13             ; first vertex
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI07,3(VI01)               ; qwords per vertex
         NOP                                      ilw.z         VI14,2(VI01)               ; instances
         NOP                                      ilw.w         VI15,2(VI01)               ; qword offset of the first instance
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI04,VI00,512              ; output base
         sub.xyzw      VF23,VF00,VF00             iadd          VI15,VI01,VI15             ; XYZ2 w = 0 (ADC off); instance pointer
         NOP                                      iadd          VI05,VI04,VI00             ; output pointer
         NOP                                      ilw.z         VI12,3(VI00)               ; vertices per triangle, 0 = no culling
; constants
         sub.xyzw      VF05,VF00,VF00             NOP                                      ; float constant
         NOP                                      loi           0x3e800000                 ; 0.25
         addi.x        VF05,VF05,I                NOP
         sub.xyzw      VF06,VF00,VF00             NOP                                      ; float constant
         NOP                                      loi           0x3e000000                 ; 0.125
         addi.x        VF06,VF06,I                NOP
tess_isolines_tese_instance:
; each instance restarts the primitive with a GIF tag of its own
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI14,VI14,1                ; instances after this one
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI08,0(VI01)               ; NLOOP with EOP
         NOP                                      sq            VF04,0(VI05)               ; the instance's GIF tag
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI08,VI08,0x4000
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI14,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_eop ; the last instance keeps EOP
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI08,VI08,0x4000           ; delay slot: EOP off
         NOP                                      isw.x         VI08,0(VI05)               ; more instances follow
tess_isolines_tese_eop:
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI05,VI05,1
         NOP                                      lq            VF24,2(VI01)               ; y = winding sign of the first triangle
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI02,1(VI01)               ; vertices per instance
         NOP                                      iadd          VI03,VI10,VI00             ; first vertex
         NOP                                      iadd          VI06,VI01,VI09             ; index pointer
         addy.z        VF24,VF00,VF24             iaddiu        VI11,VI00,3                ; the third vertex completes the first triangle
         NOP                                      sq.z          VF24,1(VI01)               ; the current triangle's sign
tess_isolines_tese_loop:
; indexed batch: the list holds each vertex's qword offset from the first
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI09,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_fetch ; vertices in order: VI03 already points at the next one
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI08,0(VI06)               ; index
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI06,VI06,1
         NOP                                      iadd          VI03,VI10,VI08             ; vertex it refers to
tess_isolines_tese_fetch:
; load inputs (location order; the pipeline repoints each at its binding's stream)
         NOP                                      lq            VF10,0(VI03)               ; location 0
; input conversion: the pipeline patches each input's 4 pairs for its attribute format
tess_isolines_tese_Convert:
         NOP                                      b             tess_isolines_tese_body    ; retargeted past the inputs that need nothing
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         itof0.xyzw    VF10,VF10                  loi           0x3f800000                 ; integers to floats; I = UNORM/SNORM scale
         muli.xyzw     VF10,VF10,I                loi           0xbf800000                 ; scale; I = SNORM clamp
         maxi.xyzw     VF10,VF10,I                NOP                                      ; clamp to -1
         mul.xyzw      VF10,VF00,VF00             NOP                                      ; components the format lacks: 0, w = 1
tess_isolines_tese_body:
; shader body
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,768(VI00)             ; line 11: tessellation input read
         subx.w        VF08,VF00,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 11: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF07,VF07,VF08w            NOP                                      ; line 11: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         NOP                                      lq            VF08,776(VI00)             ; line 11: tessellation input read
         mulx.xyzw     VF08,VF08,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 11: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF07,VF07,VF08             NOP                                      ; line 11: OpFAdd (addition)
         NOP                                      lq            VF08,792(VI00)             ; line 12: tessellation input read
         subx.w        VF09,VF00,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 12: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF08,VF08,VF09w            NOP                                      ; line 12: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         NOP                                      lq            VF09,784(VI00)             ; line 12: tessellation input read
         mulx.xyzw     VF09,VF09,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 12: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF08,VF08,VF09             NOP                                      ; line 12: OpFAdd (addition)
         NOP                                      lq            VF09,736(VI00)             ; line 14: tessellation input read
         itof0.x       VF09,VF09                  NOP                                      ; line 14: int to float
         mulx.x        VF09,VF09,VF05x            NOP                                      ; line 14: OpFMul (multiplication)
         NOP                                      lq            VF11,736(VI00)             ; line 14: tessellation input read
         itof0.y       VF11,VF11                  NOP                                      ; line 14: int to float
         mulx.y        VF11,VF11,VF05x            NOP                                      ; line 14: OpFMul (multiplication)
         NOP                                      lq            VF12,731(VI00)             ; line 14: tessellation input read
         mulx.x        VF12,VF12,VF06x            NOP                                      ; line 14: OpFMul (multiplication)
         NOP                                      move.x        VF13,VF09                  ; line 14: OpCompositeConstruct (a vector constructor)
         NOP                                      move.y        VF13,VF11
         addx.z        VF13,VF00,VF12x            NOP
         maxw.w        VF13,VF00,VF00w            NOP
         suby.w        VF09,VF00,VF10y            NOP                                      ; line 15: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF07,VF07,VF09w            NOP                                      ; line 15: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         muly.xyzw     VF08,VF08,VF10y            NOP                                      ; line 15: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF07,VF07,VF08             NOP                                      ; line 15: OpFAdd (addition)
         NOP                                      move.xyzw     VF20,VF07                  ; gl_Position
         NOP                                      move.xyzw     VF21,VF13                  ; color output, location 0
; epilogue: perspective divide, viewport, GS formats, store
         NOP                                      div           Q,VF00w,VF20w              ; Q = 1 / w
         NOP                                      waitq
         mulq.xyz      VF22,VF20,Q                NOP
         mul.xyz       VF22,VF22,VF01             NOP                                      ; viewport scale
         add.xyz       VF22,VF22,VF02             NOP                                      ; viewport offset
         ftoi4.xy      VF23,VF22                  NOP                                      ; x, y to 12.4 fixed point
         ftoi0.z       VF23,VF22                  NOP                                      ; z to integer depth
         mul.xyzw      VF24,VF21,VF03             NOP                                      ; color 0..1 to GS range
         ftoi0.xyzw    VF24,VF24                  NOP
         NOP                                      sq            VF24,0(VI05)               ; RGBAQ
; culling: test the triangle this vertex completes
         sub.w         VF23,VF00,VF00             isubiu        VI11,VI11,1                ; ADC off; one vertex closer to a triangle
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI12,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_xyz ; no culling
         NOP                                      ilw.y         VI08,3(VI00)               ; delay slot: 1 for a fan
         NOP                                      ibne          VI11,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_shift ; triangle not complete yet
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         sub.xy        VF20,VF26,VF25             iadd          VI11,VI12,VI00             ; P1 - P0; vertices to the next triangle
         sub.xy        VF21,VF22,VF25             lq            VF24,1(VI01)               ; P2 - P0; batch header, z = winding sign
         opmula.xyz    ACC,VF20,VF21              NOP
         opmsub.xyz    VF20,VF21,VF20             NOP                                      ; z = signed area
         mul.z         VF20,VF20,VF24             lq            VF21,3(VI00)               ; area * sign, negative = cull; cull context
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI13,VI00,0x20             ; MAC flags land 4 cycles later; z negative flag
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
         mulx.z        VF24,VF24,VF21             fmand         VI13,VI13                  ; next triangle's sign; sign flag of z
         NOP                                      sq            VF24,1(VI01)
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI13,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_shift ; front facing: draw
         NOP                                      ilw.w         VI13,3(VI00)               ; delay slot: ADC bit
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      mfir.w        VF23,VI13                  ; ADC on: the GS keeps the vertex but draws nothing
tess_isolines_tese_shift:
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI13,VI11,2                ; 0 at the batch's first vertex
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI08,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_p0 ; not a fan: P0 <- P1
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      ibne          VI13,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_p1 ; a fan's P0 stays its hub
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF25,VF22                  ; the hub
         NOP                                      b             tess_isolines_tese_p1
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
tess_isolines_tese_p0:
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF25,VF26
tess_isolines_tese_p1:
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF26,VF22                  ; P1 <- this vertex
tess_isolines_tese_xyz:
         NOP                                      sq            VF23,1(VI05)               ; XYZ2 (draws unless ADC is set)
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI05,VI05,2
         NOP                                      iadd          VI03,VI03,VI07             ; next vertex
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI02,VI02,1
         NOP                                      ilw.y         VI08,3(VI01)               ; qwords per instance
         NOP                                      ibne          VI02,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_loop
         NOP                                      lq            VF24,3(VI01)               ; delay slot: z = gl_InstanceIndex
         NOP                                      iadd          VI15,VI15,VI08             ; next instance
         addw.z        VF24,VF24,VF00             NOP                                      ; gl_InstanceIndex + 1
         NOP                                      sq.z          VF24,3(VI01)
         NOP                                      ibne          VI14,VI00,tess_isolines_tese_instance
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
; send the batch to the GS and stop
         NOP                                      xgkick        VI04
         NOP[E]                                   NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
		.align 4
tess_isolines_tese_CodeEnd:
